description: Recruiters use 100Hires to track jobs, candidates, applications, interviews, and evaluations. This connector lets ChatGPT read your real ATS data and act on it — move candidates between stages, schedule interviews, send templated rejection or outreach messages, log evaluations, and create candidates from resumes. Works with your existing 100Hires account and permissions.
